## DW Migration Design Blueprint

> **SSA offering — how to engage:** If you are interested in this SSA Offering, follow the ASQ process (go/gethelp): Product Help > Pilot/Production Advisory; then put the tag #ssa-offering #dw-migration-design-blueprint in both the **Title** and **Description** fields.

**GOAL:** Help customers make an informed DW migration decision with confidence and clarity

### Overview
The DW Migration Design Blueprint is a comprehensive engagement that guides customers through assessing, designing, and planning their data warehouse migration to Databricks. Through discovery, architecture design sessions, and optional joint PoC execution, specialists help customers build a concrete business case with clear ROI and a predictable migration plan.

### Key Milestones
- **Assess and quantify** cost savings and business value with clear ROI for executive buy-in
- **Design** an AI-ready platform architecture that is secure, scalable, and cost-optimized
- **Jointly analyze and build** a concrete and predictable migration plan for business priorities

### GTM Signals — When to Engage
- Customer must migrate on-prem EDW to cloud (Teradata, Oracle, SQL Server, Netezza, SAP, etc.)
- Customer must unify and modernize DW platform from Snowflake, Synapse, Redshift, etc.
- UCO with >$60K ARR
- Customer saying: "We need a clear understanding of what the migration to Databricks looks like", "Can Databricks replace our DW?", "We are spending too much on Snowflake/Teradata/Synapse", "We need to build a strong business case for executive buy-in"

### Technical Readiness Criteria
- Ready for in-person design and planning
- Approved to install and run Lakebridge + Profiler/Analyzer tools
- Databricks workspace available (or can be provisioned)
- DW admin/dev with full knowledge of current warehouse design and applications
- Infra/cloud, engineering & security teams available and can provision data source access

### Engagement Process (5-Step Joint Execution Plan)

**Step 1 — Discovery & Assessment** (8hrs FTE / 1 wk)
- Preparation: SA sends discovery questionnaire and tools. Customer shares current architecture and tech stack
- Two 1 Hour Sessions: Q&A and kick off profiler & analyzer run. High-level walk-through of current architecture
- Next Steps: Customer sends profiler & analyzer output. SA sets up call to review and agree on agenda

**Step 2 — Architecture Design & Migration Guidance** (16hrs FTE / 2 wks)
- Preparation: SSA reviews output and current architecture (from Step 1) to create a draft of TCO, current architecture analysis, and an initial draft of future architecture (POV)
- 1-2 Day Sessions: In-person jointly design the future architecture, set migration strategy and plan
- Next Steps: SSA shares a refined target architecture proposal, migration guidance, pilot recommendation

**Step 3 — TCO + Migration Proposal** (4hrs FTE / 1 wk)
- Preparation: Customer reviews the refined future state architecture, migration strategy, pilot scope
- 1 Hour Session: Final readout of TCO + GVP Business Case, future architecture design, migration strategy
- Next Steps: Databricks and customer plan pilot scope and resource commitment

**Step 4 — Joint PoC** (80hrs FTE / 3 wks)*
- Preparation: Databricks sends details of pilot execution plan for customer to review
- 1 Hour Session + 3 Week Sprint: Joint review on pilot scope and confirm resources. Kick off pilot
- Next Steps: Joint execution on pilot

**Step 5 — Migration Readiness with Implementation Partner** (2hrs FTE / 3 wks)*
- Preparation: AE shares PS/Partner implementation options. SSA shares Migration Readiness package
- 1 Hour Session: Discuss migration options and review high-level estimate of LoE/Timeline
- Next Steps: AE/SA and customers work with Databricks PS/Partner team on detailed scoping and SOW

*Steps 4 and 5 are executed in parallel. Pilot is optional. Customers are recommended to seek PS or SI partner for DW migration in general.

### Example Workshop Agenda

**Day 1 — Data Warehouse Migration Assessment (Technical Discovery & Workload Characterization)**
- Introduction & Strategic Alignment (30 min): Define goals, review challenges (performance bottlenecks, concurrency limits, SLA misses), cloud landscape overview
- Deep Dive: Current DW Architecture (60 min): Physical architecture review, profiler & analyzer results (complexity analysis, utilization, object inventory), data modeling strategy
- Ecosystem & Dependencies Analysis (60 min): ETL/ELT pipeline architecture (orchestration, stored procedures, CDC), BI & semantic layer (consumption patterns, tooling inventory, self-service vs. curated reporting)

**Day 2 — Target Architecture & Migration Path (Target Architecture & Migration Engineering)**
- Databricks Lakehouse Architecture Design (90 min): Target architecture mapping, governance & security (Unity Catalog ACLs, row/column masking, lineage, Delta Sharing), Medallion Architecture (Bronze/Silver/Gold)
- Migration Strategy & Tooling (60 min): Lift & shift vs. refactor trade-offs, phasing (big bang vs. iterative), data migration tools (Arcion, Fivetran, Auto Loader), code conversion (Bladebridge), resourcing & skills gap analysis
- Next Steps Planning (30 min): Phase 1 pilot definition, pilot kick-off planning

### Customer Requirements
- Executive management approval to proceed
- Dedicated business owner + technical owner responsible for success
- At least one dedicated technical resource with full knowledge of and access to current EDW systems
- Ability to install, configure EDW connection info, and run Lakebridge and profiler tools
- Access to Databricks workspace with create cluster entitlement
- Infra/cloud team point-of-contact to provision access to necessary data sources and systems
- Third-party integration access (optional, e.g., dbt)
